name: Rebungered!! That Time I Got Reincarnated As A Bunger!
summary:
Have you ever wondered what it would be like to live as a Bunger from the hit game Bugsnax? Well now you can!!

Introducing...
Rebungered!! That Time I Got Reincarnated As A Bunger!

A real and actual text adventure from the Young Horses. It is not spoiler free, so if you have not completed the main game, be advised!
